15,032 reviews. 4.5 stars. Grand World Phu Quoc is not a fluke.

This massive entertainment complex at Bãi Dài packs canals, street food lanes, neon-lit bridges, and live performances into one walkable strip. Come at night. The whole place changes after dark.

First-timers: wear comfortable shoes. You will cover distance.
